status: Adopted within tested scope; overall migration and performance acceptance remain active

platformScope.nativeMeasurement: Actual macOS WKWebView; Windows and physical Android not exercised

problem: Active final-scene cache initialized and uploaded offscreen source regions of otherwise visible 510px tiles. Prior API profiling identified putImageData and ImageData allocation as major observed cold costs.

change.strategy: Only the active scene source cache at factor1 crops ImageData to inverse whole backing Canvas bounds plus the existing halo. Surface dimensions, origin, source grid and device clips remain unchanged.
change.ownership: Crop bounds are part of owner identity; changed bounds discard source tiles. Default source/mip/fallback caching remains uncropped. Dirty updates intersect cropped source bounds; transform still receives absolute source coordinates.
change.memory: Each tile accounts for full Canvas area plus cropped ImageData area, times four bytes. Source failure releases allocated Canvas/source storage; main.draw owns scene clear and backing reset.
change.structure: Inline sequential logic in existing draw/prepare ownership; no new helper, worker, runtime API or platform package.

provenance.runtimeIdentity: Measured candidate and ordinary final build have all eight identical assets. Final repository formatting changed source wrapping/trailing commas only; normalized emitted JavaScript and all eight rebuilt assets are byte-equal. The final native binary differs from the isolated measurement binary and passed its own four-process smoke.

rejectedExperiment.surfaceCropping: Cropping Canvas size/origin as well as ImageData failed ten existing strict pixel comparisons and fifteen of eighteen independent comparisons. Kept as rejected; no pixel tolerance weakened.
rejectedExperiment.harnessCorrection: Initial ImageData-failure extension wrongly required caller-owned scene storage to vanish before main.draw cleanup. Source was already released. Corrected harness checks source release, then actual caller-equivalent clear/reset, then retry. Not recorded as a product leak.

permanent.oracle: Existing uncropped PixelTileCache plus shared paint/compare harness. Frozen baseline renderer comparisons are separate transition evidence; no renderer copy added to permanent tests.

functional.scope: Functional comparisons are exact Canvas RGBA on the tested cases, preserving authoritative raw RGBA. Source-level fractional matrix ratios do not certify actual fractional-DPR devices.
